current_prompt.body:
DETERMINE whether there exists any assignment of the values 1, 2, 3 to variables x, y, z that satisfies all of the following
x != y, y != z, z != x, x + y + z = 4, x >= y, y >= z.
IF solutions exist THEN ENUMERATE all such solutions.
ELSE PROVIDE a minimal explanation of the conflicting constraints.

current_plan.body:

IF any assignments remain THEN ENUMERATE each satisfying assignment
ELSE PROVIDE a brief explanation of why the constraints conflict
